text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you have a lot to do, make a plan and give each task a realistic amount of time. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and important tasks first, and do the smaller ones later. Sometimes you need scope management, which means deciding what you can realistically finish and cutting things that are not essential. Finally, communication matters. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your team or manager early, explain the problem, and suggest a new plan. These habits help you stay calm and meet your deadlines.
